title: 6th Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/3/2026 to 3/3/2026).

Written question from Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed to the Minister of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development Dr Abdulla Muttalib: what is the total estimated budget needed to complete the projects started under the ministry, and how much has been allocated in this year's budget to carry them forward?

Written question from Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed to the Minister of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development Dr Abdulla Muttalib: on how many islands is physical airport development work currently under way, and how much more money is estimated to be needed to complete those projects?

From the Speaker's desk: under Standing Order 272(b), the matter submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru to amend Standing Order 191 is sent to the relevant standing committee for review and decision.

Debate (under Standing Order 257-13) on the petition forwarded by the Petitions Committee asking Parliament, in consultation with the relevant agencies, to find a solution exempting students who had already enrolled in courses before the 2nd amendment to the Qualifying Law Degree Programmes Regulation.
Debate (under Standing Order 257-13) on the petition forwarded by the Petitions Committee calling for the cancellation of the expensive health insurance that MPs receive but ordinary citizens do not.
First reading of the Diplomatic Missions, Consular Posts and Privileges of International Organisations Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.

First reading of the resolution submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem calling on the government to disclose all details of its agreement with Eagle Hills on the "Rasmalé" project, and to gauge MPs' views on the matter.
Report of the Economic Committee on its review of the President's nominee for Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation (under Article 8(a) of the Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010).

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on its review of the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to join the Optional Protocol to the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and submit the instrument of accession to the depositary.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to take two written questions on housing and airport projects, debate petitions on law-degree students and MPs' health insurance, introduce the diplomatic privileges bill and a Rasmalé transparency resolution, and consider committee reports on a tax nominee and the CRPD Optional Protocol.
